name: Moving average crossover (50/200)
description: TREND FOLLOWING. The golden cross and death cross: the 50-period SMA crossing the 200-period one. Canonical parameters, declared and not searched: 50/200 is the pair the literature has used since Granville popularized moving-average rules, and the pair Brock, Lakonishok and LeBaron tested in 1992. BORN ON THE DAILY, on equity indices. Nothing about it was designed for intraday bars: on M5 a 200-period average spans a few hours, which is not the same object as a 200-day trend, and the crossings become far more frequent and far more often noise. Exits normalized on ATR so the same file means the same thing on every instrument.
